new_account_content.subject: Welcome to Integral Zen!
new_account_content.body:
Hi *recipient->usr_first_name*,

I want to sincerely welcome you to our sangha.

All of your course and event registrations, links, and recurring donations are available in the "My Profile" section of the website (click "My Profile" in the top right). {password_temporary}

We have created a password for you: *password*

{end} {~password_temporary}

Your password is: *password*

{end}

We have resumed in-person retreats, but here are also some things you can do remotely on our site (integralzen.org):

  • Sign up for our newsletter to get notified of online events
  • Start joining us on our Sunday Dharma calls. (Also, there are about three months of Sunday calls archived in the My Profile section of the website to get you caught up).
  • Our Level 1 self-paced Whole Spectrum of Shadows course has been released.
  • Book an appointment with one of Doshin's priests for an introduction to Integral Zen. You can go over your meditation practices and get basics and advice.
  • We have a reading list on the website that you can browse. I would highly recommend anything by Ken Wilber, "The Method of No Method", and "The Body Keeps the Score" for trauma. This will give you a map of how we're putting everything together.
  • Also, we are always planning retreats, so stay tuned.

If there's anything that we can help with that isn't listed here, please let us know.
